name: Nitemazepam
summary: A new research chemical benzodiazepine based off the chemical structure of nimetazepam. There is very limited information on the drug. The drug is suggested by anectodal reports to be similar to temazepam.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It is the 7-nitro instead of 7-chloro analogue of temazepam, and also the 3-hydroxy derivative of nimetazepam, and an active metabolite. It is metabolized to 7-aminonitemazepam, nimetazepam, 3-hydroxynitemazepam, temazepam, and nimetazepam glucuronide.

uses.text: Nitemazepam (or 3-hydroxynimetazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative which was first synthesised in the 1970s but was never marketed. It has in more recent years been sold as a designer drug, first being definitively identified in Europe in 2017.
